product_name: Bajaj Life Group Sampoorna Jeevan Suraksha
regulatory_descriptor: A Non-linked Non-Participating Group Micro Term Life Insurance Plan
variants: Joint Life Option 1 (single Sum Assured on both lives)

key_benefits: Base Death Benefit (Prevailing Sum Assured) at nominal cost; covers employer-employee and non-employer-employee groups

Optional in-built covers: Accidental Death Benefit (ADB), Accelerated Accidental Total Permanent Disability Benefit (AATPD), and/or Accelerated Critical Illness Benefit (ACI), each 10%-100% of Death Benefit
Choice of Level or Reducing cover; suited to protect against loan-repayment liability (lender-borrower schemes)
Policy Term from 1 month to 180 months; Single and Regular premium options
Joint Life option; Death Benefit payable as lump sum or in instalments

key_terms.free_look_note: 30 days from receipt of the Policy Document (except where policy tenure is less than a year); processed within 7 days.
key_terms.grace_period: Regular premium: 30 days (yearly/half-yearly/quarterly); 15 days (monthly). Single premium: grace period not applicable. Cover continues during grace period; due-but-unpaid premium deducted from benefit.
key_terms.suicide_clause: On death by suicide within 12 months from Date of Commencement of risk (or latest revival), the suicide-clause refund applies; covered for Single Life and both Joint Life options as detailed in the policy.
key_terms.maturity_benefit_condition: No maturity benefit under this plan (pure term/protection).
key_terms.surrender_note: Surrender Value availability depends on premium/cover option; not available for Regular Premium Level Cover or short-term Single Premium Level/Reducing Cover. No policy loan available.
key_terms.tax_note: Premium and benefits 'may be eligible' for tax benefits per extant Income Tax Act; consult a tax consultant. GST per prevailing tax laws.

claims_marketing_must_support: This is a pure-risk GROUP term plan with NO maturity benefit — any 'returns'/'maturity'/'money-back' framing is unsupportable.

ADB, AATPD and ACI are OPTIONAL in-built covers chosen at inception (10%-100% of Death Benefit, AATPD% + ACI% capped at 100%) and cannot be changed during the term — must be qualified as optional and selection-bound, not automatic.
Under Reducing Cover the Prevailing Sum Assured declines per the inception schedule — any cover-amount claim must reflect level vs reducing choice.
Surrender Value is not available under several cover options — must not be claimed generally.
claims_marketing_must_avoid: Do NOT position as a savings/investment or maturity product — there is no maturity benefit, no loan, and limited/no surrender value.
Do NOT use 'guaranteed returns' / 'bonus' language — non-linked, non-participating pure protection.
Do NOT imply ADB/AATPD/ACI are always included — they are optional, selected at inception.
Do NOT describe Critical Illness or disability cover without the policy definitions and exclusions.
Tax benefits must not be stated as assured — always carry the 'subject to prevailing tax laws' caveat.
must_state: Full regulatory descriptor: 'A Non-linked Non-Participating Group Micro Term Life Insurance Plan'
That there is no maturity benefit (pure-risk cover)
Standard disclaimer to read the policy document / certificate of insurance for full terms and exclusions
